title: HomeMade Electric Airplane
summary: Peter Sripol shows his homemade Part 103 electric airplane flying, built from hobby brushless motors and batteries. The video covers the first flight out of ground effect.
why: Cited as an example of a hobbyist building and flying a real human-carrying electric plane, and as a channel worth following for DIY aircraft builds.

quote.text: If anyone is interested in this kind of stuff (fiberglassing fuselages, building cockpits...)
